prova:
ext x
simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_Icc, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
constructor
· rintro ⟨n, ⟨hn0, hn6⟩, rfl⟩
  -- compute the nth EHS number for n from 0 to 6
  -- We can use decide/eval by unfolding or case analysis.
  interval_cases n <;> decide
· rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl)
  · use 0; decide
  · use 1; decide
  · use 2; decide
  · use 3; decide
  · use 4; decide
  · use 5; decide
  · use 6; decide
